free_tier.stated: DevPass paid plans start at Lite USD 29/month (USD 58 included usage), Pro USD 79 and Max USD 179. LLM Gateway offers free models on the free tier without buying credits and BYOK is free; the 5% platform fee applies only when buying prepaid credits.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: a subscription meters usage, not objects

retention.stated: not applicable: the vendor serves the inference; no caller-stored bytes

egress.terms: not applicable: the vendor serves the inference

tooling: OpenAI-compatible API; DevPass Code, Claude Code, OpenCode, Cursor and Cline, plus a self-hosted AGPLv3 gateway
chaining: the free route is BYOK or the free model catalogue; the flat-price DevPass plan is the paid alternative and its daily pacing caps the allowance

limits.value: DevPass Lite USD 29/month for USD 58 of monthly model usage
daily pacing caps each rolling 24h window at 8-10% of the monthly allowance

identity_cost.detail: an LLM Gateway account and a key; BYOK and free models need no card, while paid DevPass and credit top-ups are card-backed

reliability_note: a 5% fee is added at credit purchase and 1.5% for international cards; refunds are limited to 14 days while under 10% used

evidence.quote: Free models are available on the free tier without buying credits.
evidence.proved: free models are available on the free tier without buying credits

evidence.quote: Bringing your own provider keys is free, and self-hosting is free under AGPLv3.
evidence.proved: BYOK is free and the 5% fee applies only to credit purchases
DevPass Lite is USD 29 per month with an included allowance and daily pacing

notes: Qualifies-with-caveat. The free route here is BYOK or the free model catalogue on the vendor gateway, not the flat-price DevPass subscription; no public read path was probed.
